nodes.name: Recipe Library API
nodes.notes: Public read-only endpoint for the recipe library and recipe details. Firebase credentials remain server-side.

nodes.name: Normalize Library Request
nodes.notes: Validates ID, cuisine, and page parameters before querying Firebase.

nodes.name: Library Request Valid?
nodes.notes: Checks whether ID, cuisine, and page parameters are valid before querying Firebase.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, error: { code: 'invalid_library_request', message: $('Normalize Library Request').item.json.errorMessage } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Invalid Library Request
nodes.notes: Returns a controlled HTTP 400 response for invalid library request parameters.

nodes.name: Read Recipes from Firebase
nodes.notes: Reads the protected Firebase recipe library using the server-side Google Service Account. No Firebase credentials are exposed to Angular.

nodes.name: Build Library Response
nodes.notes: Validates Firebase records, merges favorite counts, derives the six most-liked recipes, filters by cuisine, sorts newest first, and paginates server-side with 20 recipes per page.

nodes.name: Respond Library
nodes.notes: Returns validated recipe detail data or paginated library results to the Angular frontend.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  request_id: null,
  client_ip: null,
  status: 'failed',
  stage: 'firebase_library',
  error_code: 'firebase_read_failed',
  error_message: 'Firebase library read failed.',

  metadata: {
    id:
      $('Normalize Library Request').item.json.id,

    cuisine:
      $('Normalize Library Request').item.json.cuisine,

    page:
      $('Normalize Library Request').item.json.page
  },

  created_at: $now.toISO()
} }}

nodes.name: Log Firebase Library Error
nodes.notes: Writes an audit log for Firebase read failures without storing recipe data or secrets.

parameters.subject: Code-a-Cuisine: Firebase library error
parameters.text:
Die öffentliche Recipe-Library konnte Firebase nicht lesen.

Bitte n8n/Firebase-Ausführung kontrollieren.

nodes.name: Email Firebase Library Error
nodes.notes: Sends a technical notification when reading the Firebase recipe library fails.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: false, error: { code: 'firebase_read_failed', message: 'Die Rezeptebibliothek ist momentan nicht verfügbar.' } } }}

nodes.name: Respond Library Error
nodes.notes: Returns a controlled HTTP 502 response after a Firebase read failure.

nodes.name: Read Favorite Counts
nodes.notes: Reads persisted favorite counters from Firebase before the library response is assembled.

nodes.name: Normalize Favorite Request
nodes.notes: Validates and normalizes the recipe identifier supplied by the public favorite endpoint.

nodes.name: Favorite Recipe API
nodes.notes: Public POST webhook that accepts one recipe favorite action and delegates validation and persistence.

nodes.name: Increment Favorite in Firebase
nodes.notes: Atomically increments the selected recipe favorite counter in Firebase Realtime Database.

nodes.name: Respond Favorite
nodes.notes: Returns a successful favorite acknowledgement after Firebase persisted the increment.

nodes.name: Respond Invalid Favorite Request
nodes.notes: Returns HTTP 400 when the favorite request does not contain a safe recipe identifier.

nodes.name: Favorite Request Valid?
nodes.notes: Routes valid favorite requests to Firebase and invalid requests to the controlled 400 response.

nodes.name: Log Firebase Favorite Error
nodes.notes: Writes an audit log for Firebase read failures without storing recipe data or secrets.

parameters.subject: Code-a-Cuisine: Firebase favorite error
parameters.text:
=Ein Recipe-Favorite konnte nicht in Firebase gespeichert werden.

Recipe ID:
{{ $('Normalize Favorite Request').item.json.id }}

Bitte n8n/Firebase-Ausführung kontrollieren.

nodes.name: Email Firebase Favorite Error
nodes.notes: Sends a technical notification when reading the Firebase recipe favorite fails.

nodes.name: Respond Favorite Error
nodes.notes: Returns a controlled HTTP 502 response after a Firebase read failure.
